# PROCESS — iteration cand_0002 (parent cand_0001, val 0.620)

Capability under edit: the agent system prompt (`prompt.md`). Diagnosis was done by
reading THIS iteration's `./trajectories/` (final code the agent wrote + the graded
feedback + the exact preview/instruction the agent received). Serial diagnosis — the
trace set is small and the key evidence is in each trace's preview + code.

## Key mechanic discovered this iteration (grounds every edit)
The `spreadsheet_content` preview the agent is given ALREADY CONTAINS THE DEMONSTRATED
ANSWER for the visible file — for sheet-level tasks a second sheet ("Output" / "wanted
results" / "output for reference") is previewed holding the finished result, and for many
cell-level tasks an adjacent example column or the instruction's own worked "input→output"
example spells out the exact transformation. Confirmed in traces:
- 325-44: preview shows the `Output` sheet with the exact split + cross-product expansion
  (`specialtyId IN LIST 66,77` × `contextId IN LIST 55,689,213` → one row per combination).
- 450-9: instruction "see tab for wanted results"; 110-2 / 587-38 similar demonstrated sheets.
- 5192: instruction states `CH02A1456 → 1456CH02`; agent's code produced `1456CH02A` (kept
  the trailing letter) — a self-test against the stated example would have caught it.
- 59259: instruction states exact expected YTD values ("if select Jun … machinery is 100").
- PASSING 1563/46897/48354/41297: their previews show the demonstrated example column and
  their correct code reproduces it exactly — i.e. reproducing the shown example is precisely
  what the passing tasks already do (so the rule is a no-op for them).
The current prompt only warned "do not paste the sample / example" — for the weaker reader
(gpt-5.5) that discourages USING the demonstration at all. The gap is the missing
distinction: DERIVE the rule from the shown result and self-verify against it, but COMPUTE
(don't paste) so the hidden re-runs still pass.

## Ranked cluster list
| rank | cluster | tasks | root cause | tag | lever |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Wrong transformation logic despite a demonstrated answer in the preview / instruction | 325-44, 450-9, 110-2, 587-38, 5192, 353-29, 39046, 51359, 59259, 3911, 11842, 30709 | Agent does not treat the shown Output sheet / example column / worked example as the spec, and never checks its code reproduces it | KNOWLEDGE + STRUCTURE | new "shown result is your specification" section + checklist self-test precondition + worked example |
| 2 | Over-engineering an explicit conditional rule | 59667 (invented year-interpolation where instruction said "if blank return blank") | Agent adds inference the instruction did not request | KNOWLEDGE (narrowing/literal) | "implement exactly the stated conditional logic; no unrequested fallback" line |
| — | Idiosyncratic per-task algorithm w/ no demonstrated answer & no shared prose fix | 53367, 56996, 55931, 38332, 50630 (partly) | Genuinely task-specific logic; prose can only help via cluster-1 self-test | (partly covered) | no task-specific prose (would overfit) |

## Edits kept (all ADDITIVE; original text unchanged except appended checklist item)
1. **New section "The shown result is your specification — reproduce it, do not paste it"**
   (KNOWLEDGE + STRUCTURE + worked example). Tells the agent the preview/instruction
   demonstrations ARE the transformation spec; derive the rule + value types + row
   expansion from them, reproduce every shown example by COMPUTING it, and fix the logic if
   the computed result doesn't match a shown example. Includes a generic derive-vs-paste
   worked example.
2. **Checklist item 5 (STRUCTURE, pre-finish precondition)**: reproducing every shown
   example on the visible data is now a precondition of saving — "do not save a mismatch".
   (old item 5 → 6.)
3. **"Implement exactly the conditional logic the instruction states" line** (KNOWLEDGE,
   literal/narrowing): blank→blank means write blank; no guessed/interpolated fallback;
   use the demonstration only to resolve UNSPECIFIED details, never to override an explicit
   rule. Targets 59667.

## Verify-the-fix (trace → what the edit changes) + blast radius
- 5192: code output `1456CH02A` ≠ stated example `1456CH02` → checklist item 5 forces a
  self-test against the stated example → agent revises the rule before saving. General.
- 325-44: agent overwrote the `Output` demonstration with its own wrong parse → new section
  makes the previewed `Output` rows the spec (per-combination row expansion, column order,
  int/float types) → agent builds code to reproduce them. General (cross-product rule
  derived from the demo, not hardcoded).
- 450-9 / 587-38 / 110-2 / 353-29 / 59259: each has a demonstrated result or explicit
  expected values; the derive+self-verify loop directs the logic toward matching them.
- 59667: instruction "if C blank return blank" but agent interpolated from nearest year →
  edit 3 makes it write blank and drop the invented fallback.
- **Blast radius: BOUNDED / additive.** For the 27 passing tasks the edit is a no-op:
  1563/46897/48354/41297 already reproduce their shown example column (verified in traces);
  formula-writers (52021/46897/55060/55667/58109) are untouched (no formula ban added, per
  cand_0001's preserved lesson); no global decision/permission/refusal rule was loosened.
  The new rules only fire when a demonstration/example is shown, which is exactly the
  failing class, and they REINFORCE what passers already do. Edit 3 is additive guidance no
  passing task's gold answer contradicts (none pass by inventing unrequested fallback).

## Built on / did NOT re-try
- Built on cand_0001 (ACCEPTED, +0.107): kept its "hidden re-run", "type-exact value-only
  compare", "only values graded", generalize-don't-hardcode content verbatim; this iteration
  ADDS the missing derive+verify-against-the-demonstration piece those left implicit.
- Did NOT re-introduce a global "always write literals / never formulas" ban (cand_0001
  flagged it UNSAFE — 5 passing tasks recalc formulas). Did NOT touch the range-restriction
  or error-recovery rules. cand_0001 broke {353-29, 587-38} by its additions; this iteration
  does not alter those additions, only adds the demonstration-matching lever (which directly
  targets 353-29 and 587-38).

## Deliberately skipped
- 53367 (G3 boolean "out of order"), 56996 (dropdown price lookup), 55931 (chart-position
  diff), 38332 (unique-count) and 50630 (sentence split) have no shared prose-fixable gap
  beyond cluster 1 and no demonstrated answer strong enough to pin the exact rule; adding
  task-specific prose would overfit and fail the REAL/SAFE tests. The cluster-1 self-test
  helps where an example exists, but I did not hand-code any task's algorithm.
- No ENVIRONMENT fault this iteration (73-45's recalc infra issue from cand_0001 was already
  fixed/accepted; all current failures produce an output file that mismatches on values).

## Process & features used
- Subagents/worktrees: not used — small trace set; evidence was the preview+code in each
  trace, read directly. One coherent lever (demonstration-matching) + one narrow literal-rule
  line, applying two DIFFERENT improvement types (knowledge-with-worked-example, and a
  structural pre-finish precondition).
